intent: Make the confirmed hard-block versus explicitly accepted missing-external-dependency distinction executable as pure policy before archive/merge runtime is ready.

architecture.hexagonal: Future decoder/validator adapter -> HOST trusted report mapping -> WORK evaluate_import_preflight -> immutable decision. No new output port or actual archive parser in S1.
architecture.dependencies: M01 project/document identity and M04 revision binding are context; M05 material validity and future M06 decoder supply observations. None are mutated.
architecture.ownership: External package bytes and target document remain owned by original source/target boundary. A preflight report/decision is derived evidence, not a new document SSOT or authority to write.
architecture.mutation: None. No extraction, identity allocation, reference remapping, Undo entry or filesystem path access. HOST must bind verified source and target revisions before actual apply in later slices.
architecture.transaction: S1 returns a pure decision. Real verified-source capture, staged merge/rollback and single Undo are later separately approved transactions; Allowed is not a commit receipt.

public_boundary.function: evaluate_import_preflight(report: &ImportValidationReport, context: &ImportPreflightContext, choice: IncompleteImportChoice) -> Result<ImportPreflightDecision, ImportPreflightError>
public_boundary.ImportBlocker: kind: UnsupportedFormat | UnsupportedVersion | Integrity | MissingInternalPayload | UnsafePath | AmbiguousEntry; subject:String; reason:String
public_boundary.note: Nested blocker-kind enum and data DTOs only. HOST must create this report from actual verified bytes and validation, never from UI claims that a package is safe.

InvalidInput.field: RFC6901 JSON pointer, rooted at /report, /context or /choice; indices decimal zero-based

validation_order: each /report/blockers/i: kind, subject, reason in ascending index
contract.string_validation: No trim/normalization. Check Empty -> ContainsNul -> TooLongUtf8. Whitespace-only nonempty IDs/diagnostics remain literal data in this pure slice; HOST must apply authoritative identity rules. UTF-8 bytes, not scalar count. Digest syntax exact sha256:+64 lowercase hexadecimal; any mismatch InvalidDigest.
semantic_precedence: after ALL structural input validation, nonempty blockers -> Blocked before freshness or cross-document checks
no blockers: source digest mismatch -> StaleSource
then target ID or revision mismatch -> StaleTarget
then empty missing list -> AllowedComplete regardless of choice
contract.blocker_duplicate_policy: Keep identical blockers, including exact duplicates. Sort stable by kind ordinal then subject UTF-8 bytes then reason UTF-8 bytes; every supplied valid reason remains represented. Missing dependency IDs alone sort/deduplicate by UTF-8 bytes. No locale sorting/casefold.
contract.typed_boundary: Actual Rust report/context revisions are u64 and enum values are closed. InvalidRevision/InvalidChoice/InvalidBlockerKind are reserved future decoding oracle errors, NOT constructible L0 Rust values. No serde/decoder added to this slice. Do not count impossible enum/out-of-range construction as executable domain RED.
contract.authority: Clarifies unapproved M06-R1-R4 proposal; not adopted product behavior. Full archive/schema/extract/Undo remains separate.

envelope.scope: Only proposed module declaration + pure preflight data/function/tests. No actual merge mutation in this file/slice.
envelope.future_command: cargo test -p sgenaxis-work --test phase1_import_preflight --no-run --locked then same without --no-run

decisions.approve: Pure normalized report/context boundary in WORK, no decoder/IO/mutation/SSOT allocation; only trusted HOST report in future integration, Allowed not commit/execute authority.
Structural first-error validation then hard-block -> source freshness -> target freshness -> cross-document -> optional external acceptance; internal payload/path/integrity never bypassed.
Exact source digest and document ID/u64 revision match; reject cross-document mutation; no actual merge/apply/Undo in this slice.

Declared bounds and byte-order diagnostics; preserve identical blockers, deduplicate only missing IDs; exact three-file envelope and 64 fixture/oracle plans. Whitespace-only bounded strings remain literal data; future HOST identity validation is separate.
